svg.metadata: {"design_basis": "Independently authored orthogonal pin-coordinate layout for each device, not paper conversion.", "purpose": "Native 2-field horizontal layout retains all boundaries and the original teaching frame aspect. No pictorial detail omitted. Colour and country identity require the separate key; contours alone are not unique country identifiers.", "teaching_key": {"kind": "flag-layout-context", "orientation": "horizontal", "ordered_colour_roles": ["blue", "yellow"], "limitation": "Geometry teaches field count, orientation and proportions. It does not encode colour or uniquely identify the country; use the external key. Historic source dimensions are superseded by nominal_svg_dimensions."}, "physical_evaluation": "pending", "pattern": "No filled material is represented; field boundaries express the layout. No invented colour-to-texture mapping."}
